DIALOGUER.Title: Dialoguer
DIALOGUER.Enabled: Play dialogue when a token enters this tile
DIALOGUER.Speaker: Speaker
DIALOGUER.SpeakerHint: Drop a token or actor, paste a UUID, or leave blank to use the nearest token.
DIALOGUER.PortraitHint: Leave blank to use the speaker's token art.
DIALOGUER.ScriptHint: One box of text. A blank line starts the next box.
DIALOGUER.ThemeHint: Look of the dialogue box. Use Test to preview.
DIALOGUER.DisplayHint: Dialogue box is the full portrait UI. Ambient floats over the speaker and fades on its own.
DIALOGUER.AmbientSizeHint: How large the floating text is. Blank uses the world default.
DIALOGUER.Hop: Hop the speaker token while it talks
DIALOGUER.HopMsHint: Time for one bounce. Lower is faster. Blank uses the world default. 160 is the original speed.
DIALOGUER.HopDurationMsHint: How long the hop and slide last. Blank uses the world default. 0 lasts for the whole line.
DIALOGUER.Slide: Slide the speaker token left and right
DIALOGUER.SlideHint: A small side-to-side sway while it talks. Uses the same duration as hop.
DIALOGUER.SlidePxHint: How far it sways. Blank uses the world default.
DIALOGUER.SlideMsHint: Time for one left-right cycle. Lower is faster. Blank uses the world default.
DIALOGUER.PlayerTokensOnlyHint: Uncheck this to test by dragging any token as GM. If a player exists in the world, the token must be assigned to them.
DIALOGUER.TypingMsHint: Blank uses the world default. 0 is instant.
DIALOGUER.BlipPitchHint: Low 50 is a rumble. High 2000 is a squeak. 980 is the default beep. Blank uses the client default.

Settings.HopMsHint: Time for one bounce. Lower is faster. Used when a tile leaves hop speed blank. 160 is the original speed.
Settings.HopDurationMsHint: How long the hop and slide last. 0 lasts for the whole line.
Settings.SlideMsHint: Time for one left-right cycle. Lower is faster.
Settings.AmbientSizeHint: Used when a tile leaves ambient size blank.
Settings.BlipHint: Short beep on each character, Undertale-style.
Settings.BlipPitchHint: Used when a tile or speaker leaves pitch blank. The default beep is 980. Lower is deeper.
Settings.GmAlwaysSeesHint: Active GMs receive every overlay even if audience is set to triggering player only.
Settings.WhisperChatHint: Post the full text as a whisper to the GM and triggering player so they can reread it.
